name: Завоювання простору з темпом (3)
description: The chessboard is a battlefield where both players try to control as many squares as possible. If your pawns are advanced, your pieces gain influence, and you achieve space gain. The most advantageous scenario is gaining space by advancing a pawn while attacking an opponent's piece. This way, you gain space with tempo.

examples.text: By advancing the d-pawn, the black knight is forced to a less favorable square.
White gains space here and also forces the black knight to retreat.

texts: Gain space with tempo. Make the right choice! Keep your center stable.
